title: Cloud channel launch readout and vendor onboarding (draft)
body:
Purpose:
This doc is a working readout + preflight checklist for publishing Redwood Inference to cloud partner marketplaces (AWS Marketplace / Azure Marketplace / GCP Marketplace) and for rapid vendor onboarding. It combines proposed listing copy, microcopy variants, required assets, billing SKU conventions, and a QA/acceptance test plan.

TL;DR:
- Objective: Ship a clean, compliant listing that communicates production-grade inference (latency, cost controls, deployment flexibility) and converts trial sign-ups.
- Status: Draft copy + checklist ready for partner review. Need final legal approval on SLA language and product SKU mapping from finance.
- Owners: Launch owner = Ava Martinez (GTM), Billing owner = Priya Shah (Finance), Security sign-off = Marco Liu (Sec & Compliance).

Target audience:
- Developers & ML engineers evaluating hosted vs dedicated vs private inference
- Platform leads evaluating procurement and SLAs

Suggested short (1-line) listing blurbs (pick one):
1) "High-throughput LLM inference: host, dedicate, or run in your VPC with predictable latency and cost."
2) "Ship LLM features fast — predictable latency, cost controls, and enterprise deployment options."
3) "Production-grade inference that scales across hosted, reserved, and private deployments."

Suggested long description (draft):
Redwood Inference delivers a unified runtime for operating large language models at production scale. Whether you want a simple hosted API, reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput, or a private VPC/on‑prem deployment for regulated workloads, Redwood provides the same developer experience and operational tooling across environments.

Key features:
- Hosted API: REST/SDK access for text, chat, embeddings, and reranking with streaming responses and function calling.
- Dedicated Capacity: Reserved GPU pools, autoscaling policies, and SLA-backed latency targets.
- Private Deployment: Customer-managed VPC and optional on‑prem package with KMS/HSM integration and audit logs.
- Observability: Token-level cost and latency breakdowns, per-route dashboards, and rollout controls (canary, A/B, automatic fallback).
- Optimize toolkit: Batching, caching, and quantization recommendations tied to your workload.

Primary use cases (bulleted copy to appear in listing):
- Real-time chat assistants and customer support automation
- Document search and semantic retrieval at scale
- Generate personalized content with cost and latency controls
- Multi-tenant SaaS features with tenant-level data isolation

Microcopy suggestions (CTA / buttons):
- Primary CTA: "Try Redwood — Free credits"
- Secondary CTA: "Request a demo"
- Trial flow microcopy: "Start free: 14 days, no credit card required"

Assets checklist (what to upload to marketplace):
- Logos: PNG (transparent) + SVG. Sizes: 512x512, 128x128. Clear space rules noted in /branding/logo-guidelines.
- 3 screenshots (800x450 or partner required sizes): Dashboard (per-route latency), Console: rollout settings, Billing: token-level cost breakdown.
- 1 explainer video link (30–60s): hosted thumbnail + iframe-friendly URL.
- One-page PDF: product brief + SLA summary (A4).
- Legal/Docs: link to T&Cs, DPA sample, SOC2 summary, privacy policy.

Technical & compliance requirements (preflight):
- Billing SKU(s) created and mapped in partner portal: suggested pattern below. (Finance sign-off required).
- SLA language reviewed by Legal: uptime % and incident response times.
- Data residency options specified per region.
- Security checklist: SOC2/HIPAA notes, KMS/HSM support, audit log retention.

Pricing and SKU mapping (working proposal):
- SKU naming convention: rwi.marketplace.<deployment>.<tier>
  - Examples: rwi.marketplace.hosted.starter, rwi.marketplace.dedicated.medium, rwi.marketplace.private.enterprise
- Billing units: per 1k tokens for hosted generation; per-hour reservation unit for dedicated capacity; enterprise flat fee for private (negotiated).
- Suggested headline pricing line (for marketplace card): "From $0.12 / 1k tokens (hosted); reserved capacity from $X/hr"

SLA & legal snippet (draft to feed to Legal):
"Redwood Inference provides SLA-backed availability for Dedicated plans and best-effort availability for Hosted plans. Critical incidents are acknowledged within 1 hour and targeted remediation time varies by plan tier. See full SLA in the product brief."

Acceptance / QA checklist (must pass before publish):
- [ ] Copy final approved by Product + Legal (JIRA GTM-4852).
- [ ] Pricing & SKUs created in marketplace sandbox and test invoices generated.
- [ ] Screenshots uploaded and verified for each partner portal (size + compression).
- [ ] Billing flow tested: trial credits issuance, overage billing, invoice formatting.
- [ ] Security page links present and firewall/VPC options documented.
- [ ] Integration test: deploy a simple sample that calls hosted API via marketplace-provisioned account (test ticket: INT-1973).
- [ ] Observability: marketplace events mapped to internal metrics (conversion, trial->paid).

Acceptance tests (detailed):
1) Provision test account via marketplace: can create API key and call generation endpoint with <50ms median token latency (best-effort for hosted).
2) Reserved capacity purchase: capacity reserved for test org; run throughput test at 90th percentile target throughput.
3) Private deployment lead: obtain onboarding checklist and test remote support workflow.
4) Billing: Create invoice for trial overage and confirm line items map to SKU labels.

Go-to-launch timeline (high-level):
- Week 0 (this doc): lock copy + assets.
- Week 1: Legal review + finance SKU creation.
- Week 2: Upload to partner sandbox + QA tests.
- Week 3: Partner review cycle and publish.
Owners:
- Launch owner: Ava Martinez (GTM)
- Billing + SKU: Priya Shah (Finance)
- Security & compliance sign-off: Marco Liu (Security)
- Partner ops liaison: Liam O'Connor (Channel)

Post-launch telemetry & success metrics to monitor (first 30 days):
- Marketplace listing views, CTA clicks, trial signups
- Trial->paid conversion within 14 days
- Average cost per trial user (token spend)
- Latency percentiles for hosted API verified via synthetic checks

Open questions / TODOs (action items):
- [ ] Finalize hosted pricing per 1k token bands (Finance: GTM-4867).
- [ ] Confirm marketplace-specific image size/format for Azure; partner ops to verify.
- [ ] Decide on whether to display full SLA in listing or link to brief (Legal preference?).
- [ ] Draft partner-facing onboarding email sequence for trial accounts (Owner: Liam).

Notes / context references:
- See internal PR for marketplace copy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-assets/pull/98
- Integration ticket: INT-1973 (sample app smoke tests)
- Legal ticket for SLA wording: LEGAL-221

Quick launch copy variants (short + punchy, for A/B testing):
A: "Production LLM inference — fast, reliable, and economical."
B: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost controls."
C: "Same API across hosted, reserved, and private deployments."

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally conversational / draft. Please comment inline with: copy edits, asset constraints, and any redlines from Legal. If we want to push an accelerated partner launch, we can remove detailed SLA from the marketplace card and surface it only on the PDF brief (faster time to publish).

-- End of draft readout --
